mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized coincides with higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 accelerates above 2.5% YoY, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals labor market tightness, which raises wage growth and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE drops below 5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below -1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO contracts by more than -1% YoY, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 2.5% YoY, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -1% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 contracts by more than -1% YoY, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6% signals labor market slack, which reduces wage growth and input costs, ultimately lowering profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 3% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO accelerates by more than 3% YoY, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not positive in more than 60% of cases.
